verdict_zh: SFT delivers reproducible gains, but the goal of a broadly strong medium/long-segment base is not met. Selected A scores 44.17 chrF++/25.11 BLEU on 112 fresh primary cases versus 41.27/21.67 for the original 3B, paired chrF gain+2.90 with 95% interval[+1.17, +4.71]. Fresh technical G8 good-candidate coverage is A 5/16, parent 1/16, older 0.8B1/16; A covers 3/6 medium but 0/6 long sources. Retain A as the current 3B translation R0 and restricted-pilot candidate, not a certified comprehensive DAPO/Efficient-ML baseline.

actor_conclusion_zh: Paired intervals support primary and technical medium/long overlap-metric gains over the parent3B; fresh G8 adds four technical groups containing both G and P/B. Relative to older0.8B, primary chrF gain is+1.84 but its interval[-0.26,+3.83]crosses zero, so comprehensive significant superiority is unestablished. General50chrF35.71vs35.24 and BLEU12.58vs14.41 show no reliable gain. Technical greedy semantics are G2/16 versus parent3B3/16; sampling/overlap gains do not establish comprehensive semantic improvement.
actor_conclusion_en: Paired intervals support primary and medium/long technical metric gains over the parent; fresh G8 adds four technical groups containing both G and P/B. Versus older 0.8B, the primary chrF gain+1.84 has interval[-0.26, +3.83], so universal significant superiority is unsupported. General 50 scores 35.71 versus 35.24 chrF and 12.58 versus 14.41 BLEU, without reliable improvement. Technical greedy semantics are G=2/16 versus parent 3/16, not a parallel gain; sampling coverage and overlap metrics do not establish comprehensive semantic improvement.
promotion_scope_zh: Promotion means the retained current translation R0 candidate and restricted short/medium pilot start; it does not certify a comprehensive formal baseline.

DAPO_pilot_zh: A restricted small pilot is conditionally reasonable; further mandatory SFT is unestablished. First confirm correct candidates/within-group contrast on an independent training/dev pool and validate semantic reward controls; then compare fixed-A standard DAPO against zero update. Keep the new holdout/G8 sources frozen for evaluation, not training selection, reward tuning or checkpoint choice. No confirmed long-source G is a current limitation, not a universal DAPO threshold or proof of RL ineffectiveness.
DAPO_pilot_en: A restricted small pilot is conditionally reasonable; another mandatory SFT round is not established. First confirm good candidates and within-group contrast on a separate training/development pool, and clear semantic reward controls; then compare fixed-A standard DAPO with a zero-update control under a small budget. Keep the fresh holdout/G8 sources frozen: do not use them to select training cases, tune reward or choose weights. No observed long-source G is a current limitation, not a universal DAPO threshold or proof that RL cannot help.
reward_conclusion_zh: Historical reward-calibration counterexamples remain failed; SFT gains do not repair them. On selected A reused technical diagnostics, reference MetricX ranks G first in all four G-covered groups, but has 59 discordant of 251 comparable G/P/B pairs; QE top 1G is 3/4. Few reused sources and same-AI review do not certify global calibration, and no reward mode is selected from this check. This round has zero DAPO updates. The new QE-filtered pool enters B, not selected A, so that filtering is not direct current-pool exposure of A.

next_step_zh: Do not default to more identical SFT or infer a 0.8B/3B capacity ceiling. Preserve A, B and older models; no training or reselection follows this final independent evaluation. Separate the next questions: (1)recheck short/medium candidate coverage on another verified training/development pool, repair failed reward controls, and run fixed-A restricted standard DAPO versus zero update with independent quality/semantic evaluation; (2)if broad long-segment strength remains the goal, first screen starts with demonstrable English-Icelandic ability on verified technical data, then change only one SFT adaptation factor, such as LoRA rank, under matched data/budget. Higher rank, embedding updates and full tuning are untested and no remedy is guaranteed. Repair discovered reference defects/domain mislabels and obtain disjoint review; scorer filtering is not semantic certification. This final set has now been inspected, so freeze a new test for the next final acceptance.
